single_biggest_gap.title: The offer gate is enforced at open() and not at resolve()
single_biggest_gap.measured: On a character that has joined nothing and holds reputation 0, questOpen('Q-LEDG-07') is refused with 'requires Q-LEDG-06 first; the topic "the underwriters gate" has not come up yet; the topic "the veto minute" has not come up yet; the_wet_ledger rank 0/6; the_wet_ledger reputation 0/90', and questResolve returns {ok:false, reason:'quest not open'} — the control passes. After a single questReveal() the same questResolve returns ok:true and applies world_flags [ledger_first_chair_settled, ledger_first_chair_vacant, corrano_took_it_to_the_assize, ledger_exposed_from_inside], unlocked [Q-LEDG-08], faction_reputation to four factions including +40 to the rival Assize, and NPC dispositions. ledger_first_chair_vacant is the rank-7 world_state term; derived rank moved 0 to 1.
single_biggest_gap.cause: game/src/sim/quest/machine.js resolve() line 465 gates only on record existence; reveal() calls this.rec(id, true), which creates that record. machine.js:541 guards the journal branch of setFlag() with this.rec(h.quest) && !this.isClosed(h.quest); machine.js:540, the reveal branch immediately above it, is unguarded.
single_biggest_gap.blast_radius: 0 of 110 hooks.json rows carry a quest+reveal pair today, so the world-side path (setFlag -> reveal -> record minted) is LATENT rather than a live player exploit; it becomes reachable the first time any hook adds a reveal, which the schema permits and machine.js:540 already reads. It is live for MEASUREMENT now: faction-probe.mjs:207 calls questReveal for every requires_knowing immediately before questResolve at :210, and its questOpen calls at :246 and :294 discard the return value — so every resolution in every faction-probe walk was applied outside the offer gate.
single_biggest_gap.remedy: (1) Gate machine.js resolve() on the same canOffer/open predicate and return its reason when it refuses; have reveal() mint a knowledge record distinct from the quest record, or require the quest to be open. (2) Guard machine.js:540 the way :541 is already guarded. (3) Re-run faction-probe.mjs and expect it to go red — that is the point.

other_findings.title: The arbitration is settled in the faction builder's favour; build-viability.mjs is the wrong instrument
other_findings.measured: The reputation term leaves Q-LEDG-08's gate.unmet at exactly 112 — present at 111 ('The Wet Ledger reputation 111/112'), absent at 112, unchanged to 300. Identical on Q-ASSZ-08 and Q-XULA-08. Null control 60->61 moves nothing. Statically, the player holds 249 / 208 / 228 reputation at the moment the rank-7 quest is tested. build-viability.mjs:1191 does c.reputation = new Proxy({}, { get: () => 100 }) — a literal left over from the old generated ladder whose rank 7 was 100 — while granting gold 1e9, ranks 7, all topics and all flags. Its 0 of 540 is the tool colliding with its own stub constant; its line 1599 quotes the stop verbatim.
other_findings.remedy: Derive the counterfactual's reputation from the book (sum of best-per-quest deltas), or grant Infinity as it already does for gold. One line.

other_findings.title: The rank-7 seat has never been vacated by play in any recorded run
other_findings.measured: All three faction-probe reports on disk end their P10 string with '(the probe poked in <assize_prefect_vacant | ledger_first_chair_vacant | deepkin_speaker_vacant> to clear rank world_state terms)'. The rank-5 and rank-6 world_state flags ARE in the raised-by-the-quests list on every line; the rank-7 one never is. The chooser adds +10000 cost to any violent resolution at faction-probe.mjs:187 and then takes the cheapest, so on all three lines it selects the refuse ending of the rank-6 quest — res_refuse_hulen, res_refuse, res_tell_the_hollow — which are exactly the endings that do not vacate the seat. P4 ('rank 7, never set') and P9 ('walked without killing') are individually true and jointly untested.
other_findings.remedy: Change the chooser to prefer, at each rank, a resolution that satisfies the NEXT rank's world_state term, and delete the poke entirely.

other_findings.title: A refusal permanently caps the ladder at rank 6
other_findings.measured: Q-ASSZ-07 res_refuse_hulen, Q-LEDG-07 res_refuse and Q-XULA-07 res_tell_the_hollow are the only endings on their quests that do not raise the vacancy flag, so the succession quest is unreachable on the refusal path with no alternative offered. RI-QST02 D4 requires refusal to be a way to win, not a way to lose.
other_findings.remedy: Give each line a second route to the vacancy that a refuser can take, or let the refusal vacate the seat by another mechanism — Q-ASSZ-07 res_resignation shows how.

other_findings.title: questDef() exposes no resolutions and no consequences — the trimmed view, half repaired
other_findings.measured: harness/api.js:1514-1529 returns id, title, category, giver, opens_by, directions, rank_gate and mutually_exclusive_with. questResolutionRequirements() covers the requires half only; the consequences half is invisible. Confirmed live: sections.harness_exposes_resolutions = false. This is why the builder poked the flag rather than picking a vacating ending, and my own probe had to read resolution ids off disk.
other_findings.remedy: Expose resolutions with their consequences on questDef().

other_findings.title: Q-XULA-01: at rank 1 the best-paying answer is a kill with nobody to talk to
other_findings.measured: res_kill_the_crew, violence_required true, +28 own-faction reputation (the highest on the quest), deceit null, no talk_to_target reveal anywhere on the quest. One of the 18 D6 failures and the only one this piece added.
other_findings.remedy: Add a talk_to_target reveal to the crew and a non-violent resolution paying at least 28.

other_findings.title: RI-QST02's D6 Comparison method is vacuous — corpus debt, not a build defect
other_findings.measured: kill_required_npcs is empty on all 94 quests, so the item's jq check (map(select((.kill_required_npcs // []) | length > 0))) returns the empty set and D6 passes without measuring anything.
other_findings.remedy: Read D6's prose definition (a combat resolution against a named NPC), or populate the field.

other_findings.title: Topics are real — the 74-of-76 defect has not recurred
other_findings.measured: 404 topic ids on disk, 0 with an empty body, 0 dangling topic-to-topic links anywhere in the tree. 50-factions.json ships 31 topics, median 3 infos and 485 characters each, every one with outbound links. Exactly one opens_by topic on the three lines has no body: Q-MAG-10's 'the witness', pre-existing; 37 tree-wide, none of the other 36 on these lines.
other_findings.remedy: None — this is a pass and should be recorded as one.

other_findings.title: The line lengths are 10 / 9 / 9, and Q-XULA-02 does not exist
other_findings.measured: The three new files hold 9+8+8 = 25 quests, but the census by faction is the_imperial_assize 10, the_wet_ledger 9, the_xul_aneekh 9, because Q-LEDG-01 (blackmarsh-core.json), Q-DEEP-01 and Q-MAG-10 are pre-existing quests already tagged to these factions. Q-XULA-02 exists nowhere; Q-DEEP-01 fills the rank-2 hole.
other_findings.remedy: Write Q-XULA-02, and count each line as it is rather than as authored.

other_findings.title: gen-faction-gates.mjs depends on a browser-generated report with no staleness check
other_findings.measured: The attribute column reads reports/faction-signature-sweep.json and the generator throws if it is absent, so regenerating gates requires a browser run to have happened first — and a stale sweep silently re-derives the ladder against an old character builder. notes_for_successor says so; the file does not.
other_findings.remedy: Stamp the sweep with the character-builder data hash and refuse a stale one.

other_findings.title: Mutual exclusion works, and it is the best-implemented thing in the piece
other_findings.measured: Joining the Wet Ledger at reputation 300 put the_imperial_assize, the_ixtu_vakh and the_xul_aneekh into rivalry_locked_now and left 0 of 10 Assize quests offerable. Holding both memberships capped both at derived rank 4 against a declared rank_ceiling_with_a_second_membership of 5. The closure is spoken: 30 lockout reasons, e.g. 'The Imperial Assize will not deal with you: you are The Wet Ledger' and 'The Xul-Aneekh will not deal with you: you are The Imperial Assize and The Wet Ledger'.
other_findings.remedy: None — but note GAP-FCT-01: this refusal is spoken by open() and is not enforced by resolve().

path_to_ten: Fix GAP-FCT-01 first, because every other number depends on it: gate machine.js resolve() on the offer predicate and guard machine.js:540 as :541 is guarded. Then re-run faction-probe.mjs and expect it to go red — a probe that does not go red here was never measuring the ladder.

Walk to the seat: change the probe's chooser to prefer a resolution satisfying the NEXT rank's world_state term, delete the flag poke, and report which of the three lines reaches rank 7 non-violently unaided. All three should; none has been shown to.
Expose resolutions and consequences on questDef(). Until a probe can see what an ending changes, no probe can pick one, and the poke comes back.

Volume 9 to 18 minimum, 24 to hit the bar: +2 hidden/weird quests per line (discovery found|overheard, currently 0 of 6), a second quest at ranks 0-3 and 5-7 to lift mean-quests-per-rank over 2.0, and Q-XULA-02 to close the rank-2 hole.
Give Q-XULA-01 a mouth: a talk_to_target reveal and a non-violent resolution paying at least what res_kill_the_crew pays.
Stop a refusal ending the ladder: a second route to the vacancy that a refuser can take, on each of the three lines.

RI-CRM02: build the second sanctioning authority — the ku-vastei Ruling, the only one reaching the interior jurisdiction — before writing the twenty-sixth writ, and ship factionLawFactor on the guard ladder. One multiplier, measurable in a trace, and the AR-3 crossing this piece was supposed to make.
Deceit at rank 7 on Q-LEDG-08 and Q-XULA-08, which arrive at the seat with deceit null while Q-ASSZ-08 shows what the beat is worth.
File the D6 method defect against the corpus rather than the build.
method_deviations: tools/quests/critic-faction-arbitration.mjs (critic-written): reputation sweep 0-300 per line against the live offer gate with a null control at 60->61; a 140-signature worst-build sweep; three exclusivity trials reading rivalry_locked_now and the spoken reasons.

tools/quests/critic-faction-ceiling.mjs (critic-written): the rank-6 ending perturbation with a null control. Reads resolution IDS from the authored file because questDef() exposes none; every behaviour comes from the engine.
tools/quests/critic-faction-gate-bypass.mjs (critic-written): the GAP-FCT-01 falsification, with a passing negative control that goes red when the record is absent.

Scratchpad static re-derivations, independent of faction-probe.mjs: rep-ceiling.mjs (attainable reputation ceiling), qst-bars.mjs (RI-QST01/QST02 count tables), d3-d6.mjs (dissenter and talkable-target audits), topics2.mjs (topic bodies and dangling links), crm-topics.mjs (writs, expulsion, topic supply).

Two of my own instruments went red for their own reasons and are reported in the verdict body rather than suppressed: the topic-body extractor read responses/entries/variants and called 31 live topics empty (the bodies are under infos[].x), and the first worst-build sweep took min() over favoured attributes where gate.js takes max(). Neither number is used above.
All three browser tools reuse a single launched browser at --width 320 --height 240 with setRenderRate(0).
unmeasured: Whether GAP-FCT-01 is reachable in normal play today — 0 of 110 hooks.json rows carry a quest+reveal pair, so the world-side path is latent. Claimed as a certain MEASUREMENT failure and a structural LATENT gameplay failure, not as a live exploit.

RI-QST01 section 7's blind rank-band test (redacted titles assigned to rank bands by a fresh judge) — requires a second agent with no exposure to the lines. My qualitative reading is not a substitute and is not scored as one.
RI-QST02 section 8's blind read (three Morrowind briefs against three of ours) — both items are blind_pair: yes and I am not blind to either.
RI-CRM02 section 5's factionLawFactor arrest-threshold spread (target 5.3x) — no factionLawFactor exists in game/src, so there is nothing to perturb. Scored as absent rather than as orphan.

Whether the three lines can each be walked to rank 7 non-violently — blocked on GAP-FCT-01 and on questDef() exposing no consequences; I could not drive a gated walk without going through the same bypass I am reporting. A vacating non-violent ending exists on each line (res_resignation, res_show_the_returns, res_put_it_to_the_hollow); that it is reachable by play is unproven, by the builder and by me.
Any timing or throughput figure — the box carried 6 to 12 concurrent browsers throughout.
